entries.appliesTo: any person making an electioneering communication that uses AI to falsely portray a candidate or elected official subject to recall

dutySources.disclosure-ui: § 1463(F)(1) — 'without providing a clear and understandable disclosure on the electioneering communication that it was created using artificial intelligence'

sources.disclosure: § 1463(F)(1) — 'No person shall make or cause to be made any electioneering communication that portrays a candidate or an elected official subject to recall and that is, through the use of artificial intelligence, created, altered, or digitally manipulated in a manner that would falsely appear to a reasonable observer to be an authentic record of the actual speech or conduct of a candidate or an elected official subject to recall and that would falsely appear to replace an individual's likeness with the likeness of a candidate or an elected official subject to recall without providing a clear and understandable disclosure'
sources.scope: § 1483(33)(a) — '"Electioneering communication" means any communication, whether printed, digital, or broadcast by a media entity'
sources.penaltyMax: § 1463(H) — 'shall be fined not more than two thousand dollars'
sources.enforcer: § 1463(H) — 'or be imprisoned, with or without hard labor, for not more than two years, or both'

flags: criminal tier: imprisonment 'with or without hard labor, for not more than two years, or both' (§ 1463(H))
scienter requirement: penalty applies to whoever violates 'with the intent to injure the reputation of a candidate or elected official subject to recall or to otherwise deceive a voter' (§ 1463(H))

media-entity exemption: § 1463(I) — section does not apply to a media entity broadcasting a paid communication 'in which the broadcaster has had no input in or control over the announcement, advertisement, or electioneering communication'

disclosure form incorporated by reference: 'The form of the disclosure shall be consistent with the disclosure requirements of Subsection (E) of this Section' — Subsection (E) is not reproduced in this act
'Artificial intelligence' defined by cross-reference: 'shall have the same meaning as provided in R.S. 14:73.14' (§ 1463(F)(2)(a)) — definition not in this text

non-AI remainder: bulk of act amends campaign-finance definitions (contribution, coordinated expenditure, expenditure, electioneering communication, § 1483) and requires reports by persons other than candidates or committees whose electioneering-communication expenditures 'exceed one thousand dollars in the aggregate' (§ 1501.1(A)(1)); fits no listed family, not coded
scope enum lossy: electioneering communications cover printed, digital, and broadcast express-advocacy/vote-appeal communications, not only ads — coded 'all-communications' as closest enum
